title: Duplicates in [1, n]
prompt:
Write `FindDuplicates(nums []int) []int`. `nums` has length n, every value is in `[1, n]`, and each appears once or twice. Return the values that appear twice, in the order their second copy appears.

- Use O(1) extra space besides the result.
- Leave `nums` as you found it.

`[4 3 2 7 8 2 3 1]` → `[2 3]`
hint: Use the sign of `nums[v-1]` as a "seen v" flag, then flip every sign back at the end.
